new.x: British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald announced the Communal Award on 16 August 1932, giving the depressed classes separate electorates and 71 provincial seats. Irwin, Willingdon and Hoare did not announce it.

new.s: Consider the following statements: 1. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar represented the Depressed Classes at all three Round Table Conferences. 2. Mahatma Gandhi attended only the Second Round Table Conference (1931). Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

new.s: Which work of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, written in 1936, was a critique of Hindu orthodoxy and of Gandhi?
new.x: Annihilation of Caste (1936) criticised Hindu orthodoxy and Gandhi. The Untouchables (1948) dealt with the origin of untouchability, Thoughts on Linguistic States came in 1955, and Gulamgiri is Phule's work.

new.s: With reference to the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly, consider the following statements: 1. It was set up by a resolution of the Constituent Assembly on 29 August 1947. 2. It had seven members including its chairman, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. 3. Jawaharlal Nehru was one of its members. Which of the statements given above are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct: it was set up on 29 August 1947. Statement 2 is correct: Ambedkar as chairman plus 6 other members. Statement 3 is wrong: Nehru was not a member (UPPSC 2012 trap). So '1 and 2 only'.
new.tq: Drafting Committee: 29 Aug 1947, 1 + 6 members, no Nehru.

new.s: The Drafting Committee completed its draft in under six months, sitting for only
new.x: The Drafting Committee sat for only 141 days. 2 years, 11 months and 18 days is the time taken by the whole Constituent Assembly, not the committee; 114 and 165 are distractors.
